quotes.speaker: Paul Reed
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Reed on his preparation and consistency this season
quotes.excerpt: I'm just going out there and making sure that I'm doing all the little things.
quotes.quote: I'm just going out there and making sure that I'm doing all the little things. Recovery, sleep, putting that work in for sure, and just trying to make sure I'm staying consistent with those three things.
quotes.social_post: Paul Reed says he is focusing on recovery, sleep, and putting in the work to stay consistent this season.

structured.context: Paul Reed discusses his personal preparation and consistency during practice media availability.

quotes.speaker: Paul Reed
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Reed on improving his rebounding performance
quotes.excerpt: I know I'm better than four rebounds. I can be better than that.
quotes.quote: I know I'm better than four rebounds. I can be better than that, so I just have to go out there and do better. Sometimes it just takes me getting in the weight room, working a little harder, and I'll probably come up with more rebounds.
quotes.social_post: Paul Reed is not satisfied with his rebounding numbers, saying I know I am better than four rebounds and he plans to work harder in the weight room to improve.

structured.context: Paul Reed reflects on his rebounding performance and his goal to improve his numbers.

quotes.speaker: Paul Reed
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Reed on his defensive strategy against moving screens
quotes.excerpt: I'll be trying to avoid those as much as possible.
quotes.quote: A lot of times they call it moving screens, so I'll be trying to avoid those as much as possible. But sometimes if it's tight, I don't even want to get a moving screen, I might keep it, let them curl, and see what advantages we can get from that. It's really just a read. I'll just be reading the defense, seeing what the defense gives us.
quotes.social_post: Paul Reed explains his defensive approach to moving screens, noting that it is really just a read and he is looking to see what the defense gives him.

structured.context: Paul Reed explains his defensive approach when dealing with moving screens during games.

quotes.speaker: Paul Reed
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Reed on the importance of his signature fadeaway shot
quotes.excerpt: That's just one of them go-to moves that you got to have in the bag.
quotes.quote: That's just one of them go-to moves that you got to have in the bag. You got to be able to get a bucket sometimes and that's just one of them. You got to be able to get to that move, get to the shot. So it's really before the shot, you got to be able to get to it.
quotes.social_post: Paul Reed on his signature fadeaway, calling it a go-to move you have to have in the bag to get a bucket.

structured.context: Paul Reed discusses the importance of having a reliable fadeaway shot in his offensive repertoire.

quotes.speaker: Paul Reed
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Reed on encouraging teammate's aggressive play
quotes.excerpt: I'm probably one of the main guys telling him to go be aggressive.
quotes.quote: I'm probably one of the main guys telling him to go be aggressive, especially when we have a mismatch on him, take advantage. It's helping the team a lot. You're getting easy buckets in transition, so we're encouraging him to be aggressive.
quotes.social_post: Paul Reed says he is encouraging his teammates to be aggressive when they have a mismatch to help the team get easy buckets in transition.

structured.context: Paul Reed explains how he encourages his teammates to play aggressively to exploit mismatches.

quotes.speaker: Paul Reed
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Reed on his teammate's development and impact
quotes.excerpt: We all knew that he was a great shooter coming in.
quotes.quote: We all knew that he was a great shooter coming in, but we didn't know that he could dribble, pass, defend the way he's doing. So, I mean, it's just a huge plus for our offense and our defense. And he's a good culture guy, so this is a great piece.
quotes.social_post: Paul Reed praises a teammate for exceeding expectations, noting that while they knew he could shoot, his ability to dribble, pass, and defend has been a huge plus.

structured.context: Paul Reed praises a teammate for his unexpected development in dribbling, passing, and defense.

quotes.speaker: Paul Reed
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Reed on his teammate's defensive contributions
quotes.excerpt: I'm seeing him get a lot of blocks, a lot of steals.
quotes.quote: I'm seeing him get a lot of blocks, a lot of steals, and I'm being impressed, making me want to go out there and get some more blocks and steals. So yeah, I like to see that from him.
quotes.social_post: Paul Reed says he is impressed by his teammate's defensive contributions, adding that seeing those blocks and steals makes him want to go out and get more himself.

structured.context: Paul Reed expresses how his teammate's defensive play motivates him to improve his own defensive stats.
